reviewSamples.author: Armando DiBenedetto
reviewSamples.text: In October 2020, a car drove into our store front. That same day, RC & Son's had a temporary store front up in less than 6 hours! I would highly recommend them!

reviewSamples.author: Hazel Bolduc
reviewSamples.text: It was storming and my ceiling fan came undone, gave him a call. He came the same day, fixed my ceiling fan and went about his day! I will go with RC and Sons if I need anything else when it comes to needing a handyman.

reviewSamples.author: Susan Maynard
reviewSamples.text: RC came over on short notice to redo the installation of my storm door after a relative botched the job terribly. The door was reinstalled in a short time and it turned out excellently. I'm forever grateful to them for helping me.
